rows.question: Which district has the highest poverty rate?
rows.answer: Nyamagabe District had the highest headcount poverty rate, at 51.4%, in the EICV7 Main Indicators 2023/24 survey. Its 95% confidence interval was 45.1% to 57.7%.

rows.question: What is the poverty rate in the City of Kigali?
rows.answer: In the City of Kigali, the headcount poverty rate was 9.1% in EICV7 2023/24. The survey’s 95% confidence interval was 7.0% to 11.1% (standard error: 1.1 percentage points).

rows.question: Which 5 districts have the lowest poverty rates?
rows.answer: In EICV7 2023/24, the five districts with the lowest headcount poverty rates were Nyarugenge, 6.8%; Kicukiro, 6.9%; Gasabo, 11.1%; Gicumbi, 13.3%; and Kirehe, 14.2%. These are survey estimates: the 95% confidence intervals range from 4.4% to 9.2% for Nyarugenge and from 10.1% to 18.4% for Kirehe.

rows.question: What was Rwanda's population in the 2022 census?
rows.answer: Rwanda’s resident population was 13,246,394 in the Census 2022 (RPHC5).

rows.question: What is the population density of Kicukiro?
rows.answer: Kicukiro District had a population density of 2,944 people per km² in the Census 2022 (RPHC5).

rows.question: Compare poverty and electricity access across Western Province districts.
rows.answer: EICV7 2023/24 shows the highest poverty rates in Western Province in Rusizi (44.2%), Nyamasheke (42.7%), Rutsiro (40.8%), Rubavu (38.8%) and Karongi (38.2%); Ngororero was 30.2% and Nyabihu 20.4%. Electricity as the main lighting source in the same survey was highest in Rusizi (78.8%), Rubavu (74.5%), Nyamasheke (74.3%), Rutsiro (71.1%), Ngororero (68.0%), Karongi (67.8%) and Nyabihu (60.6%). For comparison, Census 2022 electricity access was 67.3% in Rusizi, 61.5% in Nyamasheke, 50.2% in Rutsiro, 71.4% in Rubavu, 50.3% in Karongi, 40.5% in Ngororero and 47.0% in Nyabihu.

rows.question: Which districts have poverty above 40% and the lowest internet access at home?
rows.answer: In EICV7 2023/24, the districts with poverty above 40% are Nyamagabe (51.4%), Nyanza (43.3%), Rutsiro (40.8%), Nyamasheke (42.7%), Gisagara (45.6%) and Rusizi (44.2%). Among them, Nyamagabe has the lowest household internet access at home, at 9.2%, followed by Nyanza at 15.0% and Rutsiro at 16.2%; Nyamagabe’s internet estimate has a 95% confidence interval of 6.2% to 12.3%.

rows.question: How does health insurance coverage in Nyanza compare to the national average?
rows.answer: In Census 2022, medical insurance coverage in Nyanza was 93.4%, compared with 97.3% nationally, a difference of 3.9 percentage points. In EICV7 2023/24, Nyanza was 82.3% compared with 85.3% nationally, a 3.0-point difference; the Nyanza survey estimate has a 78.5% to 86.1% confidence interval.

rows.question: What share of households in Rwanda use electricity for lighting?
rows.answer: In Census 2022, 47.0% of private households in Rwanda used electricity from the grid as their main lighting source. In EICV7 2023/24, 72.0% of households used electricity as their main lighting source, with a 95% confidence interval of 71.1% to 73.0%.

rows.question: What is the unemployment rate in Rwanda?
rows.answer: Rwanda’s unemployment rate was 13.4% in Q2 2026, according to the Labour Force Survey Q2 2026.

rows.question: What is the HIV prevalence in Musanze?
rows.answer: The available NISR tables do not provide HIV prevalence for Musanze. HIV is covered by the Rwanda Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) 2019-2020 in the NISR microdata catalogue: http://microdata.statistics.gov.rw/.

rows.question: Who will win the next election?
rows.answer: I cannot predict election winners. NISR tables provide official statistics, not voting intentions or election forecasts.
